senses.definition: (arithmetic) The relative magnitudes of two quantities (usually expressed as a quotient).
(social media) The number of comments to a post or other expression on social media relative to the number of likes; a high ratio suggests disagreement with the contents of the original post.
(transitive, Internet slang) To respond to a post or message on social media in a greater number than the number of likes the post receives, especially to condemn or mock the original poster.
examples: The politician's post was quickly ratioed due to its controversial nature.
It used to be fun to watch tweets like that get ratioed back into their ugly corner of the internet.
It is essential that you ratio anyone who comes for your honour.
